title: CED Debug - All Field Types and Nested Elements template schema
description: CED Debug - All Field Types and Nested Elements template schema generated by the CEDAR Template Editor 2.9.2-SNAPSHOT

propertyDescriptions.Text Field: A single line of free text.
propertyDescriptions.Text Area Field: Free text over several lines, for a paragraph rather than a phrase.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Field: A whole number, stored as xsd:int.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Long: A whole number in the 64-bit range, stored as xsd:long.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Short: A whole number in the 16-bit range, stored as xsd:short.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Byte: A whole number in the 8-bit range, stored as xsd:byte.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Decimal (0 dp): A decimal number entered without a fractional part, stored as xsd:decimal.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Decimal (2 dp): A decimal number carrying two decimal places, stored as xsd:decimal.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Decimal (4 dp): A decimal number carrying four decimal places, stored as xsd:decimal.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Float (3 dp): A floating-point number carrying three decimal places, stored as xsd:float.
propertyDescriptions.Numeric Double (6 dp): A double-precision number carrying six decimal places, stored as xsd:double.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal Field: A date and a time of day, to the minute, on a 24-hour clock, with a UTC offset. Stored as xsd:dateTime.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal Date (Month): A year and a month. Stored as xsd:date.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal Date (Day): A calendar date. Stored as xsd:date.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal Time (Minute, 24h): A time of day, to the minute, on a 24-hour clock. Stored as xsd:time.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal Time (Second, 12h): A time of day, to the second, on a 12-hour clock. Stored as xsd:time.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal DateTime (Day): A date, with no time of day. Stored as xsd:dateTime.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal DateTime (Second, 24h, TZ): A date and a time of day, to the second, on a 24-hour clock, with a UTC offset. Stored as xsd:dateTime.
propertyDescriptions.Temporal DateTime (Decimal Second, 12h): A date and a time of day, to a fraction of a second, on a 12-hour clock. Stored as xsd:dateTime.
propertyDescriptions.Radio Field: Exactly one of Option A, Option B or Option C, shown as radio buttons.
propertyDescriptions.Checkbox Field: Any of Option A, Option B or Option C, shown as check boxes and stored as a list.
propertyDescriptions.Single-Select List Field: One of Option A, Option B or Option C, chosen from a drop-down list.
propertyDescriptions.Multi-Select List Field: One or more of Option A, Option B or Option C, chosen from a drop-down list.
propertyDescriptions.Phone Number Field: A telephone number, entered with or without a country code and separators.
propertyDescriptions.Email Field: An email address. A value not shaped like one keeps the form invalid.
propertyDescriptions.Link Field: A web address. The instance records it as an IRI, not as a string.
propertyDescriptions.Attribute-Value Field: Name and value pairs supplied while the form is filled in. The person entering metadata names each attribute, so the template does not have to name it in advance.
propertyDescriptions.Controlled-Term Field: A term chosen from the DOID class disease, looked up in the terminology server as you type. The instance keeps the term IRI alongside its label.
propertyDescriptions.ROR Field: An organization, chosen from the Research Organization Registry (ROR). The instance keeps the ROR IRI and the registered name.
propertyDescriptions.ORCID Field: A person, chosen by ORCID iD. The instance keeps the ORCID IRI and the registered name.
propertyDescriptions.PFAS Field: A PFAS chemical, chosen from the EPA CompTox Chemicals Dashboard. The instance keeps the dashboard IRI and the substance name.
propertyDescriptions.RRID Field: A research resource — an antibody, a cell line, a tool — chosen by RRID from SciCrunch. The instance keeps the resolver IRI and the RRID.
propertyDescriptions.PubMed Field: A publication, chosen by PubMed ID. The instance keeps the PubMed IRI and the PMID.
propertyDescriptions.All Field Types (single): One instance of every field type the editor supports, none of them repeatable — the plain case a nested element has to render correctly.
propertyDescriptions.All Field Types (multi-instance): The same set of field types again, with each field repeatable, so cardinality is exercised inside an element rather than at the top level.
propertyDescriptions.Wrapper then Nested (single): A field of its own followed by a nested element, taking this template two levels deep.
propertyDescriptions.Wrapper then Nested (multi-instance): A field of its own followed by a nested element whose fields repeat, so the second level carries cardinality.
